text: When you feel something dark surrounding you. When envy reaches you, or a sadness you cannot explain will not let you go. There is a declaration so old that it breaks all of it.
Tonight, put your hand on your chest, close your eyes, and repeat in silence. I close every door through which what is not mine has entered. No foreign force has power over my life.
What is not mine, I return to the void. Where there was fear, today there is calm. Where there was crying, today there is peace. Say it silently. You do not need anyone to hear it.
Your body receives the command either way. Do this for seven nights before you sleep. On the third night something begins to move. The weight loosens. The mind clears. Sleep returns.

But a declaration protects only what is already strong inside you. The day you build peace at the root, the dark has nowhere left to enter. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
